findings.body: Item 4 explicitly requires the tests-command mismatch row to disappear after an in-place repair, but this test drifts only the two host hook files. The existing workflow case in tests/test_setup.py:219 exercises doctor without --fix, and the stale-fix cases do not repair the workflow in place. Consequently, collecting the tests-check row before repairing the workflow would pass the suite. Add a real-command case with a stale workflow eligible for repair, then assert its updated test command, absence of both workflow diagnostic rows, and unchanged HEAD.
findings.title: Not done: in-place workflow repair clears the tests-check row

findings.body: After doctor creates a current fix, an uncommitted broken Forge block in that fix's AGENTS.md leaves all the current-fix conditions satisfied. This sync.files call then raises repo.Refused: src/forge/sync.py:134-135 rejects the malformed block. Unlike the initial comparison, this call has no row-producing exception handler. The CLI prints only the refusal (src/forge/cli.py:120-122), dropping the current-fix row and any other problems doctor already collected. Catch the comparison refusal here, preserve the current-fix row, and report the broken block with its existing plain-step Fix without changing that worktree.
findings.title: Handle comparison failures inside an existing doctor fix as rows
